summary: TASK-0014 was extended from a CLI plus Skill entrypoint task into the minimum real workflow usability fix requested by the maintainer. The reference runner now has a local non-fixture Codex CLI driver route, CLI workflow failure states fail closed, branch names avoid shared-prefix collisions, and isolated workflow runs refuse dirty source worktrees instead of silently running stale HEAD.

scope_change.reason: The maintainer rejected entrypoint-only completion while the workflow could not perform a real local non-fixture run.
resulting_scope: Add a real local non-fixture AgentDriver route.
Make workflow terminal failures surface as CLI failures.
Keep fixture driver explicit and test-only.
Preserve clean isolation semantics for worktree-based execution.

details: Added a SubprocessCodexCLIClient and CodexCLIDriver implementing the AgentDriver port.
Registered driverRef codex-cli in the CLI driver registry.
Resolved codex through shutil.which so Windows command shims such as codex.CMD are found.
workflow start and workflow resume now reject terminal failure states such as error, rejected, and blocked instead of returning ok:true.
Structured CLI errors continue to emit JSON with ok:false and a non-zero exit code.
Executor, reviewer, planner, and goal reviewer prompts now include role-specific duties and expected JSON output boundaries.
Generated branch names now include an eight-character SHA-1 suffix so run ids with the same first characters do not collide.
Worktree creation now fails closed when the source repository has uncommitted changes, preventing workflow runs from silently using stale HEAD.
Documented codex-cli as the default maintainer-workstation non-fixture local route.
Kept codex-python-sdk optional and fail-closed when the package extra is missing.
Updated the runnable standard example to use driverRef codex-cli.

verification.command: uv run python -B -m unittest tests.test_git_ops tests.test_codex_cli_driver tests.test_cli -v

verification.notes: AWKP lint passed and 56 unit tests passed.
Exit code 0. Git reported only existing CRLF/LF conversion warnings.
Returned ok:true with module_id standard-harness and driver_ref codex-cli.
Returned the three default local health checks.

verification.command: uv run ahra workflow start <temporary dirty-source probe>
verification.notes: With the current source worktree dirty, the command returned ok:false and LASTEXITCODE=2 with error: source worktree has uncommitted changes; commit or stash them before starting an isolated workflow run.

verification.command: uv run ahra workflow start <temporary codex-cli probe request>
verification.notes: Before adding the dirty-source guard, a clean-base codex-cli probe reached status accepted in .runtime/ahra-runs/probes/RUN-codex-cli-probe-163059 and committed b7ae5e54e6876d86ca162cfe5eae0e250ca32c86 on branch ahra/ahra-reference-runner/RUN-codex-cli-probe-1630-2b3e37f6.

usable_when: The source repository is clean or the workflow is run against a clean checked-out workspace.
The local codex CLI is installed and authenticated when using driverRef codex-cli.
artifactDir is unique or empty for the run.
not_usable_when: The source repository has uncommitted changes. The runner now refuses this state by design.
A request uses codex-python-sdk without the optional openai_codex dependency installed.

remaining_limits: The producer cannot mark TASK-0014 complete; an independent verifier or EvidenceGate approval is still required.
The runner does not yet support dirty-source snapshot execution. Commit/stash is the required operational step before using the workflow on this repo.
The CLI does not yet provide a convenience option to generate unique run ids or artifact directories for repeated example runs.
codex-cli live runs consume local Codex execution time and depend on the user's configured authentication.
